description.value:
d12 Hit Dice; half base attack; good Will saves. No Stamina score. Darkvision 60 feet. Immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, disease, death effects, critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability damage or drain, fatigue, exhaustion, and energy drain. Uses Charisma where a Stamina-based rule requires a score; destroyed at 0 hit points unless an entry states otherwise.

This reusable record defines shared conversion behavior. Individual actors carry exact printed exceptions and totals.

system.source: World of Warcraft: Monster Guide, pp. 185-200
